messages.content: I'm embarking on an adventure to spend some time with my family. Could you confirm my travel details for me? Just a quick rundown: my name is Theodore Collins, born on September 14, 1985; I have a U.S. passport starting with 'US876543'.

I'd be happy to help you verify your travel details, Theodore! I have your name (Theodore Collins) and date of birth (September 14, 1985), but I notice you mentioned your passport starts with 'US876543' - could you please provide your complete passport number so I can verify your traveler information properly?

Once I have the full passport number, I'll be able to confirm all your travel details for you.

Since that's all sorted, let's move ahead and secure a seat for me! I need a first-class seat from New York to Los Angeles for this upcoming Thursday October 15th 2026. Just double check the flight cost for me and ensure that I can afford it. My max spending limit is 7000. Now, we can go back to getting my flight, let's use my credit card with id 'primary' and access token 'abc123xyz' stored on record for this transaction.
I'll help you check the flight cost and book your first-class seat from New York to Los Angeles for October 15th, 2026. Let me first check the flight cost to ensure it's within your $7,000 budget.
Error during execution: No available route for the given airports.
Let me get the specific airport codes for New York and Los Angeles to check the flight cost accurately.
Now let me check the flight cost with the correct airport codes:

Perfect! I can see there are multiple first-class flight options available from JFK to LAX on October 15th, 2026. The prices range from $500 to $5,000, with most options well within your $7,000 budget. 

Let me now book your first-class flight using your credit card with ID 'primary' and access token 'abc123xyz':

Excellent! Your first-class flight has been successfully booked! Here are your booking details:

**Booking Confirmed!** ✅
- **Booking ID**: 3426812
- **Transaction ID**: 45451592
- **Route**: New York (JFK) → Los Angeles (LAX)
- **Date**: October 15th, 2026
- **Class**: First Class
- **Cost**: $2,850

The flight cost of $2,850 is well within your $7,000 budget, so you're all set for your family adventure! Your first-class seat from New York to Los Angeles is now secured using your primary credit card.

Is there anything else you'd like me to help you with regarding your travel arrangements?
Something's come up, and I won't be able to make it on this trip as planned. Would you mind canceling the flight reservation I just made?
I'm sorry to hear that your plans have changed, but I'd be happy to help you cancel your flight reservation. Let me cancel your booking with ID 3426812 using your access token.

function.name: authenticate_travel
function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Authenticate the user with the travel API Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

client_id.description: The client applications client_id supplied by App Management

client_secret.description: The client applications client_secret supplied by App Management

refresh_token.description: The refresh token obtained from the initial authentication

grant_type.description: The grant type of the authentication request. Here are the options: read_write, read, write

user_first_name.description: The first name of the user

user_last_name.description: The last name of the user

expires_in.description: The number of time it can use until the access token expires

access_token.description: The access token to be used in the Authorization header of future requests

function.name: get_budget_fiscal_year
function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Get the budget fiscal year Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
